subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap-instruction authority, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only loading and warn about misplaced files?
rationale: The change intentionally crosses the documented state-versus-workspace ownership boundary and can alter existing agents' system instructions on upgrade; code review cannot choose that compatibility and trust policy.

options.title: Preserve Workspace Authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only, use per-agent workspaces for customization, and pursue the warning and documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

options.title: Approve Dual Authority
options.body: Explicitly approve `agentDir` overrides, then require documentation, focused precedence and upgrade tests, and redacted live multi-agent proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Both Directions
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers define a different bootstrap ownership or migration design.

recommendation.title: Preserve Workspace Authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only, use per-agent workspaces for customization, and pursue the warning and documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the original workspace/bootstrap ownership model and adjacent behavior decisions.
